methodHandling.otherMethods: Non-POST -> 405 {"error":"POST only"}, checked AFTER auth (an unauthenticated GET gets 401). Message differs from pptx-submit's 'Method not allowed'.

auth.notes: First check of all; userId unused - no per-user record of the job.

request.parse: content-type header must contain the substring 'multipart/form-data' (case-sensitive includes) else 400. req.formData() failure is caught -> null -> 400 'Missing "file" field'.

fields.name: file
fields.bounds: part MIME (file.type, from the part's Content-Type) in {image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, image/gif}; size > 0; size <= 4194304 bytes (4*1024*1024)
fields.validation: not a File (absent or a plain text field) -> 400 'Missing "file" field'; MIME not allowed -> 400 'file must be image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, or image/gif'; size 0 -> 400 'Empty image'; size > 4 MiB -> 400 'Image must be 4 MB or smaller'. Bytes are NOT sniffed; MIME is trusted from the part header.

request.unknownFields: Other multipart fields are ignored and not forwarded (only 'file' is sent upstream).

checkOrder: 4. formData parse + file is File (400 'Missing "file" field')
9. POST {PPTX_API_URL}/jobs multipart with single 'file' part (502 on non-2xx)

bodyShape.jobId: string = upstream job_id (SlideForge style j_xxxxxxxxxxxx); key omitted if upstream had none

body.error: Send the image as multipart/form-data with a "file" field

errors.when: multipart parse failed, or no file part named 'file', or 'file' is a text field

body.error: file must be image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, or image/gif

errors.when: part MIME not in allow-list (incl. empty type)

body.error: Image must be 4 MB or smaller

errors.when: upstream /jobs non-2xx (413/422 NOT passed through, unlike pptx-submit)
missing env, network failure, upstream non-JSON 2xx

sideEffects: Creates an upstream SlideForge conversion job (paid OCR upstream). No DB writes, no export counter increment, no ownership record.
externalCalls: POST ${PPTX_API_URL}/jobs, Authorization: Bearer ${PPTX_API_TOKEN}, multipart with one part 'file' = the original File (bytes and MIME unchanged), filename file.name || 'slide.png'. No slide_context, colours, fonts, or brand fields (image-to-slide.ts:31-40).
quirks: Accepts multipart ONLY. The plan's §6.5 'or JSON' is wrong: a JSON body gets 400 'Send the image as multipart/form-data with a "file" field'.
Auth precedes the method check (opposite of pptx-submit / pptx-deck-submit), and the 405 text is 'POST only'.
Over-size is 400 not 413. Netlify's platform request-body limit (~6 MB, not in code) applies before the handler.
MIME is trusted from the part header; bytes are not sniffed (Auxi_Connector sniffs on its side before calling).
The returned jobId is polled through /api/pptx-status and downloaded via /api/pptx-result (no dedicated status route).
No export counter increment (image-to-slide.ts has no incrementExportCounts).
